volcanite_furnace.description: Smelts items using the basic Volcanite furnace.

advanced_volcanite_furnace.description: An upgraded furnace for parallel smelting.

volcanite_worktable.description: A dedicated worktable for Obsidium crafting.

volcanite_grinder.description: Processes ores, raw metals and ingots into dusts.

magma_forge_core.description: The controller of the Magma Forge multiblock for alloy forging and tempering.

hydrothermal_condenser.description: Collects water and supports cold-resource production.

hydrothermal_lithofier.description: Produces stone resources through hydrothermal processing.

dionysian_press.description: Presses botanical ingredients for the fluid-processing chain.

advanced_dionysian_press.description: An upgraded press for botanical processing.

dionysian_distillery.description: Distills ingredients for the botanical fluid and fuel chain.

dionysian_aging_barrel.description: Ages ingredients as part of the Dionysian processing chain.

volcanite_generator.description: Burns solid fuels to supply the first powered workshop.

volcanite_steam_generator.description: Generates energy through a steam-based process.

volcanite_geothermal_generator.description: Generates energy from volcanic heat and lava.

supreme_volcanic_generator.description: A high-tier generator for the volcanic fuel chain.

aeolus_storm_turbine.description: Generates energy from wind and weather conditions.

tartarus_piston_engine.description: The controller of the piston-engine multiblock.

dionysian_bio_caldera.description: The controller of the Bio-Caldera processing multiblock.

olympian_hadron_collider.description: Runs particle collisions for rare late-game materials.

keraunos_hv_core.description: The core of the Keraunos high-voltage energy structure.

volcanite_lava_pump.description: Collects lava for processing and energy infrastructure.

poseidon_abyssal_pump.description: The controller of the Poseidon pumping structure.

volcanite_chunk_loader.description: Keeps a configured area loaded while its operating requirements are met.

geothermal_arborist.description: Automates tree harvesting and supports the botanical production chain.

demetrian_composter.description: Processes botanical inputs into compost products.

demetrian_bonsai_planter.description: Grows miniature trees for botanical production.

demetrian_sapling_barrel.description: Processes saplings in the Demetrian production chain.

demetrian_lumber_depot.description: Handles timber in the botanical production chain.

volcanite_casing.description: Structural casing used by machinery and multiblocks.

advanced_volcanite_casing.description: An upgraded structural casing for industrial construction.

synchrotron_ring_coil.description: A ring component for the Olympian Hadron Collider.

hadron_energy_port.description: An energy port for the Hadron Collider.

hadron_item_port.description: An item port for the Hadron Collider.

hadron_fluid_port.description: A fluid port for the Hadron Collider.

keraunos_hv_port.description: A port for the Keraunos high-voltage structure.

poseidon_abyssal_casing.description: Structural casing for the Poseidon Abyssal Pump.

ambrosia_feeder.description: Feeds animals using species food, grows babies, shears sheep and collects eggs in a 9×4×9 area. Redstone pauses operation.

pan_pastoral_harvester.description: Harvests surplus tagged livestock in a 9×4×9 area, preserving named, baby and tamed animals. Uses 1,200 RF per successful hit and pauses when products are queued. Exports do not require a harvest-energy reserve.
